intuition: Keep the visited URLs in order and a cursor marking the current page; visiting after going back discards the forward branch.

brute_force.approach: Store separate back and forward stacks and move URLs between them on every navigation.
brute_force.time: visit O(1), back O(min(steps,n)), forward O(min(steps,n))

optimal.approach: Use one list and a current index, truncating entries beyond the cursor on a new visit.
optimal.time: visit O(1) amortized, back O(1), forward O(1)

edge_cases: Back and forward stop at the earliest and latest visited pages.
A new visit after going back deletes all forward history.
